Nature Communications is an open access, multidisciplinary journal dedicated to publishing high-quality research in all areas of the biological, health, physical, chemical and Earth sciences. Papers published by the journal aim to represent important advances of significance to specialists within each field.

We are committed to providing an efficient service for both authors and readers. Our team of independent editors make rapid and fair publication decisions. Prompt dissemination of accepted papers to a wide readership and beyond is achieved through a programme of continuous online publication.

item.title: [6] Gapless fracton quantum spin liquid and emergent photons in a 2D spin-1 model
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: Yannik Schaden-Thillmann, Johannes Reuther

Authors: Nils Niggemann, Meghadeepa Adhikary, Yannik Schaden-Thillmann, Johannes Reuther

Score 6/10 C_MAYBE

Why: Theory of a quantum spin liquid model; relevant to broader interest in strongly correlated magnetism.

Tags: #theory #quantumspinliquid #fracton

Abstract: Gapless fracton quantum spin liquids described by higher rank gauge theories have remained elusive in microscopic quantum spin models. Here, the authors demonstrate a spin 1 square lattice model exhibiting signatures of a rank 2 U(1) fracton quantum spin liquid, including suppressed pinch points and emergent photon like excitations revealed by Green function Monte Carlo simulations.
